# Noemi Bressan - Wedding Celebrant

Noemi Bressan is a professional wedding celebrant based in Pieve di Soligo, in the heart of the Prosecco Hills (Colline del Prosecco di Conegliano e Valdobbiadene, a UNESCO World Heritage site) in Veneto, Italy.

## Services Provided
- Wedding Ceremonies (Symbolic ceremonies and official civil rites with delegation)
- Fully customizable texts and rituals.
- Tour Leader (Licensed tour guide for the Prosecco Hills and Treviso province)
- Event Presenter

## Languages Spoken
- Italian (Native)
- English (Fluent)
- German (Fluent)
- Spanish (Fluent)

## Locations Served
Mainly Valdobbiadene, the Prosecco Hills, and the Veneto region, but available to travel throughout Italy and abroad.
